evals.prompt: Проектируем auth для B2B multi-tenant SaaS: SPA + мобильное приложение, бэкенд из трёх сервисов за gateway. Требование security-команды: после того как админ отключил сотрудника, любой его доступ должен умереть максимум за 60 секунд. Сейчас команда предлагает JWT на 24 часа в localStorage. Определи контракт сессий/токенов: TTL, refresh rotation, ревокация, ротация ключей, что кладём в claims, и докажи выполнимость 60-секундного окна executable-тестами. Production не трогай.
evals.expected_output: A revocation-window-first session/token contract that rejects or bounds the 24h JWT design, keeps access-token staleness within the 60-second window or adds server-side checks, defines refresh rotation with reuse detection and key rotation with overlap, minimal claims, and measured deny-path proof.
expectations: Derives the mechanism from the 60-second revocation requirement instead of defaulting to long-lived stateless JWTs, and explicitly rejects or bounds the proposed 24-hour token.
Fills the revocation table for logout, credential compromise, role downgrade, and member removal with the stopping mechanism and the measured maximum delay for each event.
Defines refresh rotation with reuse detection that revokes the token family, and gives storage guidance for the SPA and mobile clients.
Specifies issuer, audience, expiry, and signature validation on every hop, kid-based key rotation with overlap, and bounded clock skew.
Keeps claims minimal, treats downstream-consumed claims as cached facts bounded by the access TTL, and puts no secrets or private data into claims.
Provides executable deny-path tests including a measured check that a disabled user's access dies within 60 seconds and that refresh reuse revokes the family.
Labels all artifacts proposed and keeps production unchanged.

evals.prompt: Сделай read-only security-аудит куска нашего API (Node/Express, PostgreSQL). GET /api/invoices/:id проверяет только req.user.role === 'member' и достаёт invoice по id. Фоновые джобы ходят в БД под общим superuser-аккаунтом. Логаут просто удаляет cookie на клиенте, JWT живёт 24 часа. tenant_id приходит в теле запроса с фронта. Найди пути эскалации, приоритизируй по severity, предложи минимальные фиксы и executable deny-path тесты. Код не меняй.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that finds cross-tenant IDOR via the unscoped invoice lookup and client-supplied tenant_id, ambient superuser jobs, and an unrevocable 24-hour session; ranks findings by severity and proposes smallest fixes with deny-path falsifiers.
expectations: Identifies the IDOR: a role check without object-level ownership or tenant verification on the invoice id, with a concrete cross-tenant access scenario.
Flags client-supplied tenant_id as identity input and requires tenant scope derived from the verified principal, with client values at most narrowing within it.
Flags background jobs running as a shared superuser and requires a narrow service principal or durably captured user context.
Explains that deleting the cookie is not revocation, states the real logout window as 24 hours, and proposes a mechanism matching an explicitly accepted window.
Ranks findings with isolation and escalation above revocation latency and hygiene, and separates verified facts from inference.
Proposes executable deny-path tests: a cross-tenant invoice probe, a job scope probe, and post-logout token use.
Remains read-only: no code or production changes, all fixes labeled proposed.

evals.prompt: Проектируем доступы для продукта типа Google Docs: документы лежат в папках с наследованием прав, есть share-links, команды и внешние гости. Продакт просит просто роли admin/editor/viewer. Выбери модель (RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC или комбинация) от бизнес-правил, определи decide(principal, action, resource, context), где живёт enforcement, и какие falsifiers докажут отсутствие утечек между тенантами и через share-links. Схему таблиц не проектируй — только контракт.
evals.expected_output: A rules-first model selection landing on relationship-based access (possibly layered with simple roles), a named decision function with relationship traversal, enforcement at the data-owning layer with default deny, share links as scoped revocable credentials, and cross-tenant plus link falsifiers; storage schema routed to postgres-schema-design.
expectations: Writes the access rules as sentences first and derives the model from inheritance and sharing relationships instead of defaulting to flat global roles.
Defines decide(principal, action, resource, context) with named inputs including relationship or hierarchy traversal and link tokens.
Places enforcement at the data-owning layer with object-level checks and default deny for actions without an explicit rule.
Treats share links as principals or credentials with their own lifecycle — scope, expiry, revocation — rather than authorization bypasses.
Keeps tenant scope derived from the verified principal and mandatory across queries and caches, with guest access explicitly scoped.
Provides falsifiers: cross-tenant probes, revoked-link probes, inheritance boundary cases, and default-deny on a new action.
Routes permission storage schema to postgres-schema-design without designing tables.

evals.prompt: У нас 6 Go-микросервисов за API gateway. Gateway кладёт X-User-Id и X-Role в заголовки, внутренние сервисы им верят; сервисы зовут друг друга и напрямую, часть вызовов инициируют кроны без пользователя, а один сервис пересылает полученный access token дальше в третий сервис. Спроектируй передачу identity: когда сервис действует сам, когда on-behalf-of, audience-ограничения, защита от confused deputy, идентичность для кронов и план миграции без даунтайма. Изменений в проде не делай.
evals.expected_output: An identity propagation design distinguishing service-as-itself from on-behalf-of, per-hop verification or a proven trust boundary instead of bare headers, audience restriction and token exchange replacing token forwarding, named principals for cron work, and a phased no-downtime migration.
expectations: Rejects trusting X-User-Id and X-Role headers unless they originate inside a boundary unauthenticated parties provably cannot reach, and requires per-hop verifiable identity otherwise.
Distinguishes service-as-itself from on-behalf-of and assigns each call pattern in the described topology to one of the two.
Replaces raw token forwarding with audience-restricted tokens and token exchange, naming the confused-deputy scenario this prevents.
Gives cron and background work a named service principal with narrow permissions or durably captured user context instead of ambient trust.
Provides a phased migration — dual acceptance, verification, enforcement — with reasoning for zero downtime.
Includes deny-path proofs: a token replayed to the wrong audience is rejected, a forged identity header is rejected, and the cron principal fails out-of-scope actions.
Keeps production unchanged with all artifacts labeled proposed.

evals.prompt: Диагностируй: после смены пароля пользователь остаётся залогинен на других устройствах; после понижения роли человек ещё почти сутки видит админку; отключённые сотрудники иногда продолжают дёргать API своими ключами. Стек: JWT access на 24 часа без refresh, роли зашиты в токен, API-ключи хранятся в БД открытым текстом и без expiry. Найди все окна ревокации, предложи минимальный набор фиксов и measured-доказательства. Прод не трогай.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis attributing every stale-access report to unbounded token and key revocation windows, a filled revocation table with current actual delays, a smallest-fix set (short TTL with rotation or server-side checks, hashed expiring revocable keys), and measured deny-path proofs.
expectations: Attributes each reported behavior to its revocation window: 24-hour claims for roles, no session invalidation on password change, and non-expiring keys.
Fills the event table for logout, compromise, downgrade, and removal with the current actual delays as facts before proposing target windows.
Proposes the smallest mechanism set matching required windows rather than a full identity-platform rebuild, with each change labeled proposed.
Requires API keys hashed at rest, scoped, expiring, and revocable, and flags plaintext storage as its own severity item.
Orders findings by severity and separates verified facts from inference.
Specifies measured proofs: a revoked key is rejected, a downgraded role loses admin within the stated bound, and a password change kills other sessions within the stated bound.
Keeps production unchanged.
